experiments.scope: Completion step (a variant of K5 with cell-respecting draws, caps 2^14 and 2^8) on the accepted match of the stored pair, built from our own starting solution S. Every trial draws E13/E15 from SHAKE-256 of its own organizer nonce.
experiments.hypothesis: Completion from our own S and match succeeds for fresh per-trial nonces, and each returned pair is a distinct full sha256-r31 collision. No probability inference is drawn.
